synergies.short_description: Burning areas spread into damaging tornado zones.
synergies.long_description: Burning area plus Wind Shear amplifies delayed area damage and rewards enemies being held in place.

synergies.short_description: Slowed targets make chain damage more reliable.
synergies.long_description: Frozen or slowed targets create reaction windows that make Chain Lightning and electric follow-up stronger.

synergies.short_description: Displacement keeps enemies inside poison routes.
synergies.long_description: Teleport Trap displacement triggers poison reactions and buys time for damage-over-time effects to finish.

synergies.short_description: Kinetic coverage turns single-target fire into lane control.
synergies.long_description: Piercing aligned targets and bouncing between them lets precise weapons answer dense waves without losing priority damage.

synergies.short_description: Legendary sidegrades specialize the entire loadout.
synergies.long_description: Each evolution changes an ultimate’s role, adding a strength and a tradeoff that should shape the rest of the build.
